items.title: It is stupidly hard to start a pure software company right now. Customers don't want software,…
items.content: It is stupidly hard to start a pure software company right now. Customers don't want software, they want outcomes. So you end up having to do a lot of custom work for them. Anything horizontal is on a ticking clock. Every customer wants to deeply customize. There are opportunities. But you need to have a very heretical 2-3 year view of the world in order to build something good.

items.content: I have been thinking about this photo a lot. It's a beautiful testament to human civilization and our ability to reach for the stars. But man was there. And that makes it so much more evocative.
